⬥</nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Blue_dragons_(Slayer_assignment) <nowiki>Blue Dragon</nowiki>]<nowiki>/</nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Dragons_(Slayer_assignment) <nowiki>Dragon cluster</nowiki>]<nowiki> slayer task

<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=729edc31-1ce7-4c2e-bdb8-3b4ec995411f <nowiki>Necromancy preset</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F729edc31-1ce7-4c2e-bdb8-3b4ec995411f.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure that </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284342839513108.png?v=1" alt="scriptureofjas" title="scriptureofjas" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1" alt="darkness" title="darkness" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1" alt="powderofprotection" title="powderofprotection" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are active at all times</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809111178813471.png?v=1" alt="deflectnecromancy" title="deflectnecromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1" alt="ruination" title="ruination" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="ability-bar"><nowiki>Ability Bar</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/BffTpwJqGE.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="the-fight"><nowiki>The fight</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This method requires few inputs to work, but they must be done in order for it to be successful.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>There is still a low chance of death which can be fully avoided by using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to avoid Zemouregal's bone spikes attack.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ Enter Instance → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1" alt="conjurearmy" title="conjurearmy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → Target </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1278853696159088833.png?v=1" alt="vorkath" title="vorkath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayer" title="undeadslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968204883603497.png?v=1" alt="ballista" title="ballista" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upkeep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and press </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339922019516416.png?v=1" alt="undeadslayer" title="undeadslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on cooldown.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Press </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968204883603497.png?v=1" alt="ballista" title="ballista" kind="icon" /><nowiki> whenever it is available, however make sure that it is available to be pressed for when Vorkath flies @ 750k hp.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you press </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968204883603497.png?v=1" alt="ballista" title="ballista" kind="icon" /><nowiki> late or not at all, you can use a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to survive the flight damage and use the spare </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1" alt="hellhoundpouch" title="hellhoundpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Cast </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1" alt="prismofrestoration" title="prismofrestoration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after vorkath flies to keep your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1" alt="hellhoundpouch" title="hellhoundpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> alive.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1" alt="excal" title="excal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after Vorkath flies.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Walk out of the green/purple poison pools if they spawn beneath you.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Target Zemouregal after Vorkath takes flight, and re-target Vorkath when he lands.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
